## Summary

Describe the problem and the outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] `pytest`, `mypy`, and `ruff` pass
- [ ] Frontend build passes when applicable
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots are updated when applicable

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No secrets, local databases, or generated artifacts are included
- [ ] Public API and UI contracts remain compatible, or the change is documented
